generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
One similar completed item/work costing each not less than Rs. 35,20,000/- (Rupees Thirty Five lakh Twenty Thousand Only )
Two similar complete items costing each not less than Rs. 22,00,000- (Rupees Twenty Two lakh only)
Three similar completed items/works costing each not less than Rs. 17,60,000/- (Rupees seventeen Lakh sixty Thousand only)
Work Experience in Central-Govt./Central autonomous body/centralPSUs/PWDs/CPWD/MES/Railways/Public Sector
Work Experience in Reputed Private Organization
Customer Feedback: (Upto 5 marks for each customer feedback), maximum marks are 15, Contract value (taken in last 7 years) of such customers shall not be less than Rs. 1 crore (including tax).
Bidders ability to deploy minimum two sets of machineries for the asphalting work. (relevant documents to be submitted)

The bidder to give a presentation before the committee exhibiting relevant experience, Technical Capabilities, Quality of work, Project Management, Financial Stability and use of technologies required for this work.

itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work.
Removal of Unserviceable Soil with Disposal upto a suitable distance of work complete outside the site premises including charges of labour machinary complete as per specification
Preparation and compaction of sub-grade to 97% of dry density using a vibratory roller, including dressing to required camber and gradient.

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead and lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement and formwork shall be paid separately).Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.

Supplying and fixing M20 grade precast cement concrete Kerb stones for Roadway, Sidewalls and gutters fixed with CM 1:3 fixed and finsihed in line as per direction of Engineer in charge of size 600 x 450 x 150 mm size (make sobha/equivalaent)

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density. - .With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.
